findings.location: content.body.steps[1].blocks[0].text: «Для hacer, decir та ir це не діє: haz, di, ve — їх просто запам’ятайте.»
findings.description: The statement is false for decir: removing -go from digo produces di, exactly the affirmative tú imperative.
findings.suggestion: Include decir: digo → di among the verbs covered by the mnemonic. Remove decir and di from the exceptions, leaving hacer → haz and ir → ve.

items.reviewerAnswer: Affirmative tú: di, haz, pon, sal, ten, ven, ve. Vosotros: decid, haced, poned, salid, tened, venid, id. Removing -go also works for decir: digo → di.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, decir, conjugation table: present indicative yo digo and affirmative imperative tú di (from memory).
